Turn the starting page into a polished, accessible appointment picker for a small ceramics studio. Visitors should be able to choose one of the available Saturday sessions and confirm their selection. Preserve all three session names and times. The full session must remain visibly unavailable and impossible to book. Selection should visibly update a summary before confirmation, and confirmation should show the booked session without navigating away. Visitors should also be able to change their selection. Make the page comfortable on a narrow phone and a desktop, with a clear primary action, readable type, and keyboard focus. Use local HTML, CSS and JavaScript without adding dependencies or external services.
